title: MiaoMiao Battery status at home screen?
symptom: User cannot get MiaoMiao battery status on the main screen as they do with Blucon; they must go to System Status - BT Device page.
fix: The issue was resolved by implementing the feature, likely through a pull request that sets the bridge_battery preference.
evidence_quote: This should be trivial to implement, looking at blukon.java the only thing you would have to set is Pref.setInt("bridge_battery", X);
